header.label: OpenAEC Ecosystem
header.title: BCF Manager Studio
header.desc: Open-source BCF 2.1 issue management platform for BIM projects. Manage issues, communicate with teams and link to IFC models.

bcf.title: What is BCF?
bcf.desc: BIM Collaboration Format (BCF) is an open standard (buildingSMART) for exchanging issues and comments between BIM software. It enables reporting, discussing and resolving problems in a building model — regardless of which software the parties involved are using.
bcf.list2: Software-independent Works with any BIM package that supports BCF
bcf.list3: Viewpoints Visual snapshots of the 3D model for each issue

why.title: Why BCF Manager Studio?
why.desc1: Existing BCF tools are often part of expensive, proprietary BIM platforms. BCF Manager Studio offers a standalone, open-source alternative that anyone can use — free, without license fees, without vendor lock-in.
why.desc2: The platform runs locally or on your own server. Your data stays yours. Connect it to your own IFC viewer, share issues with your team, and export to any BCF-compatible package.

issues.title: BCF 2.1 issue management
issues.desc: Create, edit and manage issues conforming to the BCF 2.1 standard. Full support for topics, comments, viewpoints and snapshots.

viewpoints.title: Viewpoints with 3D snapshots
viewpoints.desc: Link visual viewpoints to issues with camera position, selection and visibility. Directly visible in your IFC viewer.

collaboration.title: Team collaboration
collaboration.desc: Assign issues to team members, set deadlines, add comments and track status. Real-time synchronization between all participants.

xml.title: BCF XML import/export
xml.desc: Import and export BCF files (XML format) for exchange with Solibri, Navisworks, BIMcollab and other BCF-compatible software.

api.title: REST API (BCF API 3.0)
api.desc: Full BCF API 3.0 implementation for integration with external tools, dashboards and automation.

projects.title: Project management
projects.desc: Organize issues per project with labels, priorities, milestones and filters. Clear dashboard with statistics.

ifc.title: IFC integration
ifc.desc: Link issues directly to IFC elements via GlobalId. Navigate from an issue directly to the relevant element in your model.

selfhosted.title: Self-hosted
selfhosted.desc: Run the platform on your own server or locally. Full control over your data, no cloud dependency.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.desc: Receive notifications for new issues, status changes and replies. Configurable per project and per user.

tech.title: Technology
tech.desc: Built with the same technology stack as the entire OpenAEC ecosystem: a Rust backend for performance and security, a TypeScript frontend for usability, and Tauri 2 for cross-platform distribution.
